title: Hot Choc Chilli Cubes
description: Dark chocolate and cream set into ice cube moulds with chilli oil to create instant hot chocolate cubes — just dunk in hot milk and stir.
steps: Wash and dry an 18-cube silicone ice-cube tray.
Chop the chocolate into small pieces and mix with the chilli oil in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the cream in a saucepan until it starts to bubble. Remove and pour over the chocolate mixture. Whisk vigorously until all chocolate has melted.
Fill the ice-cube moulds with the hot chocolate mixture. Refrigerate for an hour until starting to set, then insert lolly sticks.
Freeze for 2 hours to set. Store in the fridge or freezer.
To serve: heat full-fat milk with a whisk, then dunk a cube and stir until dissolved.
notes: Makes 18 cubes. Per cube estimate. Keep in fridge or freezer between uses.
